verdict.rationale: Superset is agent-agnostic: it documents running Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Amp, OpenCode, Cursor Agent, or any CLI agent, so a lead picks the vendor and model by picking the agent. It never documents its own model selection or LLM API-key configuration; credentials and model choice stay with the external agent CLIs. missing for 10: documented BYO LLM API-key configuration, explicit per-agent model selection inside Superset, independent corroboration of model-choice workflows.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can bring my own LLM or API key so agents run on the model of my choice
